name: Belaydesk
summary: A finance and HR back office for climbing gyms with a drag-to-sort desk for bills and requests
about: A bright back office for a small business with several sites, shown with four climbing gyms. The Desk is the heart of it: bills, receipts, timesheets, leave requests, contracts and refunds land in an inbox, and you drag each one into Approve, Pay, File or Ask, then process a whole tray at once. A month waterfall, live check-ins per gym, weekly cash, staff, expenses and documents sit around it, reached from a floating dock.
how: On the Desk, drag a card from the Inbox into a tray, or use its ⋯ menu; cards that do not belong in a tray bounce back with a reason.
Press Approve all: approved bills and refunds move on to Pay and signed contracts move on to File.
Pay a tray to take the money from the main account, File a tray into Documents, or Ask and watch the answers come back.
Click Check for new mail, or wait, and new paperwork drops into the inbox.
On Overview, read this month as a waterfall from the starting balance to now, per gym or for all four.
Watch live check-ins tick on the Gyms page and switch the weekly cash chart between 8W, 12W and 26W.
